To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a major endo-1,4-β-D-glucanase was purified from the extracellular fluid of Erwinia carotovora and characterized.
an extracellular endo-β-glucanase of Erwiniae chrysanthemi strain 3665 has been partially characterized.
a carboxymethylcellulase from Ervinia chrysanthemum has been purified and partially characterized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
an endo-enzyme which is not able to attack the microcrystallites of the cellulose but is capable of hydrolyzing the amorphous regions of the polymer.
an enzyme which could be considered as an endo-1,4-β-glucanase with a preference for amorphous celluloses.
the purification of an endo-cellulase from E. chrysanthemi and its partial characterization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the enzyme is an endo-1,4-β-glucanase, which has a preference for carboxymethyl- and phosphoric acid-cellulose.
the enzyme was an endo- β-1,4- glucanase with a broad specificity.

the endo-β1,4-glcanase of E. chrysanthemi strain 3665 is an endo-1,4-β-glucanase with a very high capacity for the hydrolysis of amorphous celluloses, but with a very low capacity for the hydrolysing crystalline celluloses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the carboxymethyl cellulase of Erwiniae chrysanthemi 3665 is a single enzyme, with a molecular size of 45 kD, a p I of 4.3 and a pH optimum of 6.5–7.0.
the enzyme was an endo- β-1,4-glycanase which was able to hydrolyze carboxymethyl- cellulose, phosphoric acid-swelled cellulose and to some extent microcrystallin cellulose.
the enzyme is an endo-1,4-β-glucanase, which hydrolyses carboxymethylcellulose to cellobiose, cellotriose and cellotetraose.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the enzyme is a very efficient hydrolytic endo-β-glucanase which is capable of degrading the cellulose chain in the middle of its length.
the extracellular carboxy-methyl-cellulase is an endo-1,4-β-glucanase which is able to degrade carboxymethyl- cellulose and phosphoric acid swollen cellulose.
this enzyme is a very good tool for the degradation of carboxymethylellulose and phosphoric acid swollen cellulose.
